mapper.select: SELECT node_id, node_code, node_name, parent_node_id, hierarchy_level, display_order, is_active FROM org_node ORDER BY hierarchy_level, COALESCE(display_order, 9999), node_code
SELECT node_id, node_code, node_name, parent_node_id, hierarchy_level, display_order, is_active FROM org_node WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} LIMIT 1
SELECT node_id, node_code, node_name, parent_node_id, hierarchy_level, display_order, is_active FROM org_node WHERE node_code = #{nodeCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT node_id, node_code, node_name, parent_node_id, hierarchy_level, display_order, is_active FROM org_node WHERE parent_node_id = #{parentNodeId} ORDER BY COALESCE(display_order, 9999), node_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org_node(node_code, node_name, parent_node_id, hierarchy_level, display_order, is_active) VALUES(#{nodeCode}, #{nodeName}, #{parentNodeId}, #{hierarchyLevel}, #{displayOrder}, COALESCE(#{isActive}, TRUE))
mapper.update: UPDATE org_node SET node_name = #{nodeName}, parent_node_id = #{parentNodeId}, hierarchy_level = #{hierarchyLevel}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE node_id = #{nodeId}
